title: George Isaac Harmon
repository: Delaware Native American Archives / Mitsawokett Collection
transcriber: Archival Transcriber / Written in the Genome
citation: "George Isaac Harmon." Historical Document Record (2014). Preserved in the Nanticoke & Moor Historical Archive (Written in the Genome Collection).
lines: George I. Harmon was born Sunday, May 23, 1948 to the late Leon and Sarah Harmon, in Lewes, Delaware. He passed away peacefully at home on the morning of Tuesday, November 18, 2014. He attended school at Rabbit's Ferry in Lewes and the William C. Jason Comprehensive High School in Georgetown, Delaware. He met Mildred Thompson and they married on March 18, 1968; they were blessed with two children. He enjoyed farming and spending time with his family; his life was spent as a truck driver, husband and father. He is survived by his wife of 46 years, Mildred Harmon; one daughter, Mildred (Shannon) Reddix of Lewes; one son, George Harmon, Jr. of Lewes; three sisters, Marion Harmon of Silver Spring, Maryland, Sarah Snipes and Linda Wheeler of Lewes; three brothers, Leon Harmon, Jr. of Milton, Rodney Harmon of Lewes and Robert Harmon of Virginia; seven grandchildren; seven great-grandchildren; two brothers-in-law, George and Bruce Thompson of Millsboro; three aunts; and several nieces, nephews and cousins. Lovingly Submitted, The Family
